verdict.rationale: ernd is a business card offering rewards on AI-vendor spend. Spend-management products of this kind could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations or agents, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers rewards rates, partner perks, fees and card requests, with nothing about setting up autonomous automations. The 'paid off once a month' repayment is a billing term, not a user-configured automation, and the probes target an unrelated domain.
